status: written and committed before any final_test reconstruction or score exists

adaptive_routers.use: exploratory lambda sensitivity only; never refit on final

artifacts.scoring: v1: voxel_iou(pred > frozen threshold, gt > 0.5) at 32^3; backbone preprocessing as of 2026-10-01

sampling.features: final objects' features in a separate file, never a training input

primary.metric: backbone-only utility, cost v1 (IoU - 0.0771 x declared CPU seconds)
primary.test: object-level paired bootstrap, 2000 reps, seed 0, 95% percentile interval
primary.claim: improvement if the interval lies above 0; reported whatever the outcome

secondary.comparison: router_corrected vs router_plain, under random, heuristic and policy views

exploratory: the remaining pipelines of the 15-pipeline grid
lambda sensitivity, frozen and adaptive (frozen routers)

statistics.pairing: one set of bootstrap weights shared by every pipeline
statistics.timing_uncertainty: the dev timing cohort (26 objects, disjoint from final_test) resampled independently of the final objects, still paired across pipelines
statistics.multiplicity: one primary hypothesis; secondaries reported with intervals but not as confirmatory; the grid is exploratory

conditions: CPU-estimated utility is conditional on the dev CPU timing profile and its component model; it is not a claim across machine states
GPU latency is reported in seconds only: lambda is priced per CPU-second
evaluator: python build/rl_pipeline/phase3_eval.py --split final_test --views artifacts/final/views_final.json --eval-feats artifacts/final/feats_final.npz --out artifacts/final/eval_final.json
